correctness.rationale: For every compactly supported invariant Borel probability measure in the strict positive quadrant, log x and log y are smooth and bounded on support so their generator integrals vanish. The exact predator identity ωx/(1+ηx)-σ=ω(x-x*)/[(1+ηx)(1+ηx*)] gives E[(x-x*)/(1+ηx)]=0. Writing x=x*+(x-x*) in the decomposition of E[x-x*] proves E[x]-x*=ηE[(x-x*)²/(1+ηx)] ≥0. A vanishing square forces x=x* on invariant support; invariance then forces dot x=0 there and y=K(1-x*)(x*-α), hence only the coexistence Dirac. Averaging log x gives E[y]/K=E[(1-x)(x-α)]=(1-E[x])(E[x]-α)-Var(x), exactly the second formula. E[y]>0 yields α<E[x]<1. The parameter inequality is precisely α<x*<1 and makes equilibrium y*>0. Exact arithmetic independently verified both rational identities, numerical x*=110265/183841, and a nondegenerate two-point weighted-moment check. These finite checks corroborate, but do not replace, the all-measure analytic proof.
residual_risks: Compact interior support is essential for averaging log observables; no claim for axes, unbounded invariant measures or transient paths.
The proof is conditional on a compact positive stationary state; it does not prove a positive periodic cycle exists at arbitrary parameters.
Numerical example and rational algebra checker establish only the stated finite equalities, not infinite-time recurrence or novelty.

evidence: The RM result proves a stronger conditional Holling-II prey excess for logistic-prey Rosenzweig–MacArthur, with exactly identical unconditional algebra when h=1/η. This covers only the generic first law, not the source-specific paired shell.
The delayed Fan–Wolkowicz result has Holling-I delayed recruitment and its moment shell Var_T(x)=(mean x-x*)(1-mean x), unlike the current per-capita quadratic Allee law.
The Xue Allee-cooperation predator law locks mean x=x* and gives a predator deficit; the Ma–Zhao–Du law instead has strict mean prey elevation and a different predator shell.
Xie and Zu–Mimura concern rational-Allee/fear prey growth, not this normalized quadratic prey per-capita polynomial.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The closest stronger statement covers only one component at a different prey vector field. Analogous cycle-mean results for delayed or other Allee dynamics do not supply the full two-law implication; no checked general Kolmogorov averaging theorem was found that states the current pair for the exact source system.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge originality of the PAIRED source-specific invariant-measure mean-shift and predator/prey-variance-shell constraint, not the generic Holling-II Jensen bias alone. The primary Ma–Zhao–Du article was materially read, including model, positive equilibrium, Hopf and numerical cycles; it does not state the paired stationary identities. The published Rosenzweig–MacArthur fiberwise theorem supplies the identical saturating-response mean-excess algebra after rescaling h=1/η and is PRIOR coverage of that first ingredient (and even strengthens it conditionally), but is for a different prey vector field and has no stated or implied Ma–Zhao–Du quadratic-prey mean-predator shell. Xie and Zu–Mimura involve different prey equations; published delayed, cooperation and food-chain results establish analogous moment laws for different systems without an exact implication for this paired statement. No examined general theorem dominates the complete two-identity claim. An inaccessible plausible 2010 source remains a disclosed historical-priority risk, not a reason to claim proven novelty or automatic failure.
residual_risks: Generic saturating-response Jensen/weighted-square prey mean shift is already present in the stronger Rosenzweig–MacArthur fiberwise Resultary result; this component independently is not novel.

Zu–Mimura (2010) full paper was inaccessible despite lawful open-access/preprint attempts and subsequent authorized institutional request (VPN disconnected). Unread primary text could contain relevant mean identities or generalizations.
Other classical Gause/Kolmogorov periodic-average theorems may imply part of the paired model-specific result under another normalization; no exhaustive historical priority is claimed.

The second shell is an elementary consequence of the polynomial per-capita prey equation and stationarity; originality/value hinge on the precise source-specific finite-amplitude coupled interpretation rather than a new mathematical technique.

value.rationale: The natural objects are the compact positive stationary statistics and finite-amplitude periodic cycles of the established Ma–Zhao–Du strong-Allee Holling-II flow, where source research highlights Hopf-born coexistence oscillations. Beyond the familiar Jensen mean-elevation ingredient, the paired exact quadratic prey-variance/mean-predator shell controls the biological mean predator abundance in terms of mean prey density and prey fluctuation for every invariant measure, without near-Hopf or stability assumptions. The resulting strict prey-mean > x* ordering is an observable cycle diagnostic and the shell quantitatively constrains any numerical periodic-state estimates. It is a modest model-specific structural lemma, not a new global classification or a general averaging principle, yet it supplies a precise exact natural fact not found as an already stated implication of the inspected primary papers.
residual_risks: The arithmetic of both identities is short and standard once one chooses log coordinates; value is tied to the specific finite-amplitude biological interpretation, not a novel proof method or downstream general theorem.
The theorem is a necessary constraint and gives no uniqueness, existence or stability of recurrent states.
